scenarios.scenario: SPIFFE IDs are validated and certificate matching is exact
mTLS proxies require both the local token and exact workload identities

limitations: This local harness uses an ephemeral test CA and does not claim that a SPIRE agent issued the certificates.
A deployed run still requires Linux SPIRE server and agent services and AWS IID node attestation.
SPIFFE authenticates workloads; Keylime and EMILIA remain separate attestation and authorization checks.
